about: Steps in order as a winding route down the frame, a named thing moving from stop to stop as each is said, with a note at each, a way not taken at a stop and a way back to an earlier one: something going through stages, a process from start to finish, a journey, a delivery, a migration, the stages of a life.

stops.about: the stops or steps in order, split by |

notes.about: a short note at each stop, split by | (empty ones keep their place)

thing.about: the name of what goes through, written on the traveller; else a plain dot

branch.about: at each stop, the other way on that is not taken (a dead end drawn off the road), split by | (empty ones keep their place)

returns.about: ways back as FROM>TO:words, stops counted from 1, such as 4>2:sent back; split by |

when.about: moments the traveller reaches each stop; else when its name is said, or one after another
